title: Operator CLI: unified local and cloud backend

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text:
Epic intent: one papyrus command on PATH with the same argv for local pod and cloud backends. Backend is config (--backend local|cloud), not a parallel command tree. kbs stays the Kanbus board; papyrus owns newsroom objects.

Child issues:
- PPY-873378 story: executable Gherkin specs (features/operator-cli.feature)
- PPY-ebf0b6 task: backend config, default corpus/publication, resolution order
- PPY-58e740 task: cloud adapters (GraphQL Reference, Assignment)
- PPY-97625f task: local pod adapters (Kanbus project + story artifacts)
- PPY-7b8518 task: papyrus auth refresh + friendly JWT errors
- PPY-500b35 task: --help tree, no PYTHONPATH ImportError, deprecate papyrus-newsroom docs

Object-kind rule: cloud assignments = newsroom-assignment (GraphQL Assignment); local assignments list = pod-story (Kanbus story). Pod assignment stage is kbs workflow, not papyrus assignments list.
